description: This file implements a Frappe report module for measuring campaign efficiency. It defines functions to generate report columns, gather data about leads linked to campaigns, and compute statistics like lead counts, opportunity counts, quotation counts, order counts, and order values, based on specified filters.

methods.name: execute(filters=None)
methods.description: Main entry point that generates the columns and data for the campaign efficiency report.

methods.name: get_columns(based_on)
methods.description: Constructs the list of columns for the report table based on a given field name.

methods.name: get_lead_data(filters, based_on)
methods.description: Fetches lead data grouped by a specific campaign field, and computes various statistics per group.

methods.name: get_filter_conditions(filters)
methods.description: Generates SQL conditions based on provided date filters.

methods.name: get_lead_quotation_count(leads)
methods.description: Counts the number of quotations associated with a list of leads.

methods.name: get_lead_opp_count(leads)
methods.description: Counts the number of opportunities associated with a list of leads.

methods.name: get_quotation_ordered_count(leads)
methods.description: Counts the number of quotations with 'Ordered' status associated with a list of leads.

methods.name: get_order_amount(leads)
methods.description: Calculates the total order amount for quotations linked to a list of leads.
